1.outline: Term theme: 'Data & AI Art'. Enter a small dataset into Sheets or Excel with clear column headings.
1.sowResources: Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, sample dataset.
objectives: Enter data into a spreadsheet with headings.
Keep one record per row.
Check for typing mistakes in the data.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Clear headings
plan.detail: Discuss why clear column headings matter — show a table without them and one with.

plan.title: Enter the data
plan.detail: Enter a class-collected dataset with clear headings, one record per row.

plan.title: Proofread
plan.detail: Check for typing mistakes with a partner. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My data has clear column headings.
I entered one record per row.
I checked my data for mistakes.

2.subtopic: Build a Chart from the Table
2.outline: Select the data range and build a bar chart, adding a title and axis labels.
objectives: Select data and insert a bar chart.
Add a chart title.
Label the chart axes.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the chart
plan.detail: Select the data range and insert a bar chart, adding a title.

plan.title: Label it
plan.detail: Add axis labels so a reader knows what the numbers mean.

plan.title: Check
plan.detail: Partner checks the chart makes sense. Save and log out.

activities: Insert and title a bar chart
successCriteria: I inserted a bar chart from my data.
My chart has a title.
My chart's axes are labelled.

3.subtopic: Describe What a Chart Tells Us
3.outline: Practise reading a bar chart to answer questions and describe what it shows in a written sentence.
objectives: Answer questions by reading a chart.
Write one sentence describing what a chart shows.
Check the sentence matches the chart.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Reading questions
plan.detail: Answer teacher questions by reading the chart (highest, lowest, difference).

plan.title: Write it up
plan.detail: Write one sentence describing what the chart shows.

plan.title: Peer check
plan.detail: Partner checks the sentence matches the chart. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I answered questions correctly by reading the chart.
I wrote a sentence describing the chart.
My sentence matches the chart's data.

4.outline: Play an unplugged yes/no guessing game, learning that a series of branching decisions can identify something — the basis of a decision tree.
objectives: Play a yes/no guessing game.
Explain how a series of questions narrows down an answer.
Draw a simple branching decision diagram.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Play the game
plan.detail: In pairs, guess an animal using only yes/no questions.

plan.title: Draw the branches
plan.detail: Draw a simple yes/no branching diagram for the game just played.

plan.title: Discuss
plan.detail: Discuss how each answer narrows down the possibilities. Log out.

successCriteria: I played the guessing game using yes/no questions.
I can explain how questions narrow down an answer.
I drew a simple branching diagram.

5.subtopic: Write a Description for an AI Image (Guided)
5.outline: Under teacher guidance, write a short description of a scene, then use a guided AI image tool to create a picture from it.
5.sowResources: Teacher-guided AI image tool, description writing frame.
objectives: Write a clear scene description.
Use a guided AI tool to generate an image from it.
Compare the image to the description.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Describing a scene
plan.detail: Practise writing clear, specific descriptions (colours, objects, setting).

plan.title: Generate the image
plan.detail: Under teacher supervision, enter the description into the guided AI tool and generate an image.

plan.title: Compare
plan.detail: Compare the image with the original description — did it match? Log out.

successCriteria: I wrote a clear, specific scene description.
I used the guided AI tool to generate an image.
I compared the image with my description.

6.subtopic: Put the Image into a Doc or Slide
6.outline: Save the AI-generated image and insert it into a document or slide, with a caption crediting how it was made.
objectives: Save the AI-generated image.
Insert it into a document or slide.
Add a caption that says it was made with AI.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Save and insert
plan.detail: Save the AI image and insert it into a document or slide.

plan.title: Caption it
plan.detail: Add a caption that credits the image as 'made with an AI tool'.

plan.title: Check
plan.detail: Partner checks the caption is clear. Save and log out.

successCriteria: I saved and inserted my AI image.
My image has a caption crediting it as AI-made.
A partner confirmed the caption is clear.

7.subtopic: What's Real? Being Fair and Honest
7.outline: Discuss what makes AI use fair and honest — telling people when something was AI-made, and not pretending it's a real photo.
objectives: Explain why it matters to say when something is AI-made.
Discuss the difference between a real photo and an AI image.
State one rule for using AI fairly.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Real or AI?
plan.detail: Show examples and discuss: how can you tell, and does it matter?

plan.title: Fairness discussion
plan.detail: Discuss: why is it important to say when something was made with AI?

plan.title: One rule
plan.detail: Each pupil writes one rule for using AI fairly. Log out.

successCriteria: I can explain why saying 'AI-made' matters.
I discussed the difference between real and AI images.
I wrote one rule for using AI fairly.

8.outline: Share the finished document or slide with the AI image and caption, with the class.
objectives: Share the finished project with the class.
Explain how the image was made.
Give one kind comment to a classmate.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Showcase
plan.detail: Share the finished piece on the projector, explaining the AI image and caption.

plan.title: Kind comments
plan.detail: Each pupil gives one kind, specific comment.

plan.title: Save
plan.detail: Save the finished piece to the portfolio folder. Log out.

successCriteria: I shared my finished project with the class.
I explained how my AI image was made and captioned.
I gave a kind, specific comment to a classmate.

9.outline: Recap this term's skills: data entry, charts, branching decisions and honest AI use, through a station rotation.
objectives: Recap data entry, charts, branching and AI honesty.
Complete each station task.
Identify which skill needs more practice.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Station 1 — Chart
plan.detail: Read a chart and answer a question.

plan.title: Station 2 — Branching
plan.detail: Draw a small yes/no decision branch.

plan.title: Station 3 — AI honesty
plan.detail: Spot the caption that correctly credits an AI image.

plan.title: Reflect
plan.detail: Name the trickiest skill. Log out.

successCriteria: I completed all three stations.
I can recap this term's data and AI skills.
I know which skill needs more practice.

10.outline: Rehearse the practical task in pairs: build a chart from data, and write a sentence describing it.
objectives: Rehearse building a chart and describing it with a partner.
Check both for accuracy.
Identify the trickiest step.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Paired rehearsal
plan.detail: Build a small chart and write a description with a partner reading the task card.

plan.title: Tricky step check
plan.detail: Name the step you still find hardest. Log out.

successCriteria: I rehearsed building and describing a chart with a partner.
I checked both for accuracy.
I know which step needs more practice.

11.outline: Individual task: build a chart plus a project using a teacher-guided AI-made image, with a sentence on using AI fairly.
objectives: Build a chart from given data.
Include a teacher-guided AI-made image with a correct caption.
Write one sentence on using AI fairly.

plan.title: Settle and explain
plan.detail: Calm start — explain the task.

plan.title: Chart task
plan.detail: Individual practical: build a chart from given data.

plan.title: AI caption task
plan.detail: Insert a supplied AI image with a correctly worded caption and fairness sentence.

plan.title: Celebrate
plan.detail: Save and celebrate the year's progress. Log out.

successCriteria: My chart is built correctly from the data.
My AI image is captioned honestly.
I wrote one sentence on using AI fairly.

12.outline: Plan a final fact page on a chosen topic that combines a data chart and a teacher-guided AI-made illustration.
objectives: Choose a topic with data and a visual idea.
Plan the chart and the AI image together.
Sketch the plan on paper.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Plan the page
plan.detail: Choose a topic, sketch the chart and the AI image idea, and plan the layout.

plan.title: Pitch it
plan.detail: Tell a partner the plan. Collect plans. Log out.

successCriteria: My plan includes a chart idea and an AI image idea.
My plan shows a sensible page layout.
I can tell a partner my plan.

13.subtopic: AI Fact Page — Build the Chart
13.outline: Build the data chart for the fact page from the planned dataset.
objectives: Enter the data for the fact page.
Build a suitable, labelled chart.
Check it matches the plan.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Build the chart
plan.detail: Enter data and build a suitable, labelled chart following the plan.

plan.title: Check
plan.detail: Check it matches the original plan. Save and log out.

successCriteria: My data is entered correctly.
My chart is suitable and labelled.
My chart matches my original plan.

14.subtopic: AI Fact Page — Add the Image and Text
14.outline: Add the teacher-guided AI image, a caption, and the fact text to complete the page.
14.sowResources: Teacher-guided AI image tool, Microsoft Word / Google Docs.
objectives: Add the AI image with a correct caption.
Write the fact text for the page.
Check the whole page is complete.

plan.title: TypingClub warm-up
plan.detail: 10 minutes, posture check.

plan.title: Add image and text
plan.detail: Insert the AI image with its caption, and write the fact text around the chart.

plan.title: Completeness check
plan.detail: Check chart, image, caption and text are all present. Save and log out.

activities: Add the AI image and caption
successCriteria: My AI image has a correct caption.
My fact text is written.
My page has all four parts: chart, image, caption, text.

15.outline: Present the finished AI fact page to the class, then save the whole year's portfolio.
objectives: Present the finished fact page confidently.
Explain the data and the AI image honestly.
Save the whole year's portfolio.

plan.title: Final rehearsal
plan.detail: One last run-through with a partner before presenting.

plan.title: Fact Page Fair
plan.detail: Present fact pages to the class in small groups.

plan.title: Portfolio save
plan.detail: Save the finished page and review the whole year's portfolio folder.

plan.title: Year celebration
plan.detail: Name three things learned this year. Log out.

successCriteria: I presented my fact page confidently.
I explained my data and my AI image honestly.
My whole year's work is saved in the portfolio.
